title: At the Crossroads
subtitle: The Legend of the Kid and the Devil
genre: Southern Gothic folk-horror graphic novel told like a blues ballad
artStyleAnchor: highly detailed modern graphic novel panel, crisp clean ink linework with fine cross-hatching, rich digital texture, muted but high-contrast cinematic lighting, clean cel and gradient shading, no messy watercolor wash, no blur
invariants: The Kid ages across the story: 8-12 in Track 1, late teens/early 20s on the road, 24 at the crossroads, a star in his 30s, a preacher in his 40s
The Devil appears as a 7-foot shadow with glowing red ember eyes, as the Old Bluesman in a fedora with a pipe, and as the Rider of the Blackwater Devils MC
The black leather ledger bound with iron clasps is the Devil's book in every appearance
